summary: First iteration full-stack test of InstaBloom (Expo + FastAPI + MongoDB). All 13 backend tests passed including AI generate (Gemini Nano Banana ~10s) and AI edit. Frontend Home, AI Bloom generation (auto-save), Gallery preview modal, delete, and Editor empty state all work correctly. No blocker issues found. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of 201 on create (minor REST convention; frontend works fine).

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props deprecated in react-native-web; migrate to boxShadow
Console warning: 'textShadow*' style props deprecated; migrate to textShadow
Console warning: props.pointerEvents deprecated; use style.pointerEvents
